description: Single-shot LLM agent backed by Snowflake Cortex COMPLETE REST API + MCP tools. Runs the same tool-calling loop as openai_agent / anthropic_agent / gemini_agent but routes through Snowflake's inference endpoint.

outputs.description: {final_answer, iterations, tool_calls_made, tool_call_details, transcript, stopped_reason, model, mcp_servers}

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale. Defines a FreshnessPolicy.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays at 9am).

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.

retry_policy_backoff.label: Retry Policy Backoff
retry_policy_backoff.description: Retry backoff strategy: exponential (doubles the delay each time), linear (adds a fixed delay each time), or fixed (constant delay).
